companies.name: CBC Properties
companies.quote: Prior to forming Taconic with Paul Pariser, Mr. Bendit founded CBC Properties, where he acquired, repositioned and managed more than one million square feet of office properties in New York and Washington, D.C., as well as several hundred apartment units in the New York metropolitan area.

companies.name: Balfour Holdings
